task_completion.description: The correct EEG recording file is selected for playback.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the OpenBCI GUI control panel or file selection dialog, the file 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-EyesOpen.txt' is visible and selected.

task_completion.description: The Head Plot widget is active in the GUI dashboard.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A widget titled 'Head Plot' is visible in one of the dashboard containers.

task_completion.description: The Head Plot widget is configured to display 'Band Power'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Within the Head Plot widget settings or dropdown menu, the mode is set to 'Band Power' rather than 'FFT' or other metrics.

task_completion.description: The Alpha frequency band (8-13 Hz) is selected for visualization in the Head Plot.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Head Plot widget shows 'Alpha' selected in its frequency band toggle or dropdown, or the heatmap represents the 8-13 Hz range.

task_completion.description: A screenshot of the configured dashboard is saved to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent triggers the 'Screenshot' button in the GUI or a file explorer window shows 'alpha_topography.png' saved in '~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/'.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the OpenBCI GUI rather than just using terminal commands to move files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with GUI elements like the widget selector, dropdowns, and the 'Start Data Stream' button.

integrity.description: The GUI shows active data streaming/playback from the file, not a static or empty state.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Time Series or FFT widgets show moving waveforms or spectral data consistent with EEG playback.

integrity.description: The screenshot 'alpha_topography.png' is a genuine capture of the GUI state, not a renamed placeholder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The content of the saved image matches the final state of the GUI seen in the trajectory screenshots.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires the OpenBCI GUI to be in Playback mode using 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-EyesOpen.txt'. The 'Head Plot' widget must be used. The specific configuration required is 'Band Power' mode with the 'Alpha' band (8-13 Hz) selected. The final output must be a screenshot named 'alpha_topography.png' located in '~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/'.
